key_insight: QUARTZ is an AI-enabled retinal vasculometry system that improves cross-dataset vessel analysis; this paper concerns retinal imaging, not cancer drug discovery.
clinical_relevance: Automated retinal vessel measurements could support research into ocular and systemic disease biomarkers, but this abstract does not establish clinical benefit.
method: Uses 26 annotated retinal image datasets spanning diverse populations, diseases, cameras, and imaging protocols.
Segments arterioles, venules, vessels, optic discs, and optic cups, and classifies image quality.
Extracts information from lower-quality, partially illuminated images.
evidence_signal: External EPIC-Norfolk evaluation reported F1 scores of 0.8305 for arterioles, 0.8477 for venules, 0.8741 for vessels, 0.9532 for optic discs, 0.8677 for optic cups, and 0.9197 for image quality classification.
watch_item: Cross-dataset improvements were not observed for optic cup segmentation or image quality classification, indicating that generalisation gains were task-dependent.
paper_title: QUARTZ: Cross-Dataset Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Retinal Vasculometry
